title: Constructive Causal Abstraction and a Case Study in Mechanistic Interpretability
abstract: arXiv:2611.31795v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing frameworks in causal abstraction first propose a high-level causal model, and then verify whether its interventional effects agree with those of a given micro-level model - the two models are declared causally consistent when the discrepancy is zero. However, proposing a consistent macro causal model is difficult, because macro causal relations are almost never well-defined, since distinct micro-level interventions associated with the same apparent macro intervention can produce different effects. Our central insight is that causally consistent macro-level models can be obtained constructively: ill-defined macro interventions can be interpreted as missing variables on the macro level, and can be accounted for by introducing a complementary variable q that retains omitted causally relevant state. translated_title: 构造性因果抽象与机制可解释性中的案例研究
translated_abstract: 现有的因果抽象框架首先提出一个高层因果模型，然后验证其干预效应是否与给定的微观层面模型的干预效应相一致——当差异为零时，这两个模型被判定为因果一致。然而，提出一个一致的宏观因果模型是困难的，因为宏观因果关系几乎从未被良好定义，因为与同一表面宏观干预相关联的不同微观干预可能产生不同的效应。我们的核心洞察是，因果一致的宏观层面模型可以通过构造性方法获得：定义不良的宏观干预可以被解释为宏观层面上的缺失变量，并通过引入一个保留被遗漏的因果相关状态的补充变量 q 来加以处理。在线性情形下，q 具有唯一的形式，并且我们给出了有效实现存在的充分条件；在非线性情形下，（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出构造性因果抽象方法，将定义不良的宏观干预解释为宏观层面的缺失变量，并通过引入补充变量 q 保留被遗漏的因果相关状态，从而构造性地获得与微观模型因果一致的宏观因果模型，并在机制可解释性中进行了案例验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes constructive causal abstraction, which interprets ill-defined macro interventions as missing macro-level variables and accounts for them by introducing a complementary variable q that retains omitted causally relevant state, thereby constructively obtaining macro-level models that are causally consistent with micro-level models, demonstrated through a case study in mechanistic interpretability.
